notice: Light Saturday edition — fewer fresh items than usual, but quality picks across research, tools, and funding.

lead.title: Introducing Claude Opus 5
lead.summary: Anthropic launched Claude Opus 5, a step-change improvement for the Opus tier powering long-running agents with improvements in coding and professional work.

top_stories.title: Anduril reportedly in talks to raise funding at $100B valuation
top_stories.summary: $40B+ raise at ~$100B valuation (3x last year's mark), defense tech/AI drones, talks ongoing per Reuters

top_stories.title: "Open Weights and American AI Leadership" — 25 US Companies Sign Policy Letter
top_stories.summary: A major policy letter titled 'Open Weights and American AI Leadership' was released July 24, 2026, co-signed by 25 US companies including NVIDIA (Jensen Huang's first ever X post), Meta, Microsoft, IBM, Mistral AI, Hugging Face, and Mozilla, arguing open-weight AI models expand American AI leadershi

top_stories.title: Jensen Huang Posts on X for the First Time — Shares NVIDIA's Open Weights Letter
top_stories.summary: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang made his first-ever X post on July 24, 2026, sharing the 'Open Weights and American AI Leadership' letter signed by 25 US companies including NVIDIA, defending open-weight AI models as critical to US AI leadership.

top_stories.title: OpenAI Presence — Enterprise AI Agent Platform Generates Discussion Throughout July 24-25
top_stories.summary: OpenAI's enterprise product 'Presence' for deploying trusted voice and chat AI agents remained a hot topic on X through July 24-25, with analysts noting its significance for enterprise AI agent deployment with guardrails and Forward Deployed Engineers.

items.title: AREX: Towards a Recursively Self-Improving Agent for Deep Research
items.summary: BAAI presenta AREX, una famiglia di agenti deep research con auto-miglioramento ricorsivo. Alterna ricerca interna e un loop esterno di self-improvement che verifica le risposte vincolo per vincolo. Un modello 122B-A10B MoE supera baseline comparabili su BrowseComp, WideSearch e Humanity's Last Exam

items.title: OpenForgeRL: Train Harness-native Agents in Any Environment
items.summary: Microsoft presenta un framework open-source per addestrare agenti harness-based (Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw) end-to-end via RL. Usando solo centinaia/migliaia di task, OpenForgeClaw raggiunge 31.7 pass^3 su ClawEval e OpenForgeGUI 72.3 su WebVoyager, superando baseline aperte di dimensioni simili

items.title: Windowed-MTP: Removing the Full-Context Draft-KV Tax at Million-Token Context
items.summary: Propone una sliding window + attention sink per il draft head di MTP/NEXTN, riducendo del ~99% il KV cache del draft a 1M di contesto. Su Qwen GDN-MoE 35B/122B e Mamba2-hybrid 120B, taglia il costo per step del 28-44% senza perdita di qualità, essendo il full-attention target a decidere i token acce

items.title: JAXBench: Benchmarking Autonomous TPU Kernel Optimization
items.summary: Google presenta JAXBench, benchmark TPU-native con 50 workload JAX. Con Gemini 3 Flash, la documentazione curata alza la correttezza per-sample dal 5.8% al 37.3%, risolvendo 48/50 benchmark con speedup 1.28x. Autocomp raggiunge 1.36x geomean su XLA e 1.60x sui kernel ottimizzati a mano.

items.title: DC-Leap: Training-Free Acceleration of dLLMs via Draft-Guided Contiguous Leaping Decoding
items.summary: Framework training-free che accelera i Diffusion LLM del 53.19x su MBPP per sequenze lunghe, e fino a 105.02x combinato con KV-Cache. Introduce Dynamic Contiguous Verification che neutralizza il Joint Probability Dependence Error (JPDE), consentendo decoding parallelo anche in regime di confidenza m

items.title: Test-Time Scaling via Error Localization (TTEL)
items.summary: Algoritmo inference-time che con feedback identifica il token esatto dove avviene l'errore, tronca la traiettoria e rigenera riusando il prefisso valido. Con Qwen3-8B su LiveCodeBench raggiunge pass@64 del 71.0% generando la metà dei token rispetto a independent sampling (360.4k vs 735.0k).

items.title: OpenAI AI Keypad — hardware peripheral for coders
items.summary: OpenAI launched a physical AI keypad peripheral designed for coders, offering quick access to AI completions and code generation directly from a dedicated hardware input device. Reviewed by TechCrunch as fun for some coders and mystifying to others.

items.title: GitHub Copilot Cloud Agent for Linear — generally available
items.summary: GitHub made its Copilot cloud agent integration for Linear generally available, allowing teams to assign Linear issues to an asynchronous coding agent that produces draft pull requests for review.

items.title: Health in ChatGPT — connect health records for AI health conversations
items.summary: OpenAI launched a U.S. rollout letting eligible ChatGPT users connect health records and supported wellness data for more contextual health conversations, powered by GPT-5.6 Sol on paid plans.

items.title: Bluesky Attie — AI assistant expands into open social research tool
items.summary: Bluesky's AI assistant Attie expanded to let users ask questions about news, trends, and conversations across Bluesky and other AT Protocol apps, acting as an open social research tool.

items.title: Pushary — native mobile apps for approving AI agent requests from lock screen
items.summary: Pushary launched native iPhone and Android apps that put AI agent approval requests on your lock screen. One command connects Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Hermes, and Claude Cowork to your phone.

items.title: Fluree AI — enterprise context layer for AI agents
items.summary: Fluree AI gives every app and AI agent the same trusted context from company data, providing cited verifiable answers from a live data layer with permissions checked on every request, connecting to MCP-ready agents.

items.title: NVIDIA AI Summit: South Korea Unveils Multitrillion-Dollar AI Semiconductor Push with Jensen Huang, Sam Altman, and Tech Titans
items.summary: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung issued the 'San Francisco AI Declaration' at the NVIDIA AI Summit, joined by Jensen Huang, Sam Altman, Hock Tan, and Dario Amodei. items.summary: Intel is planning layoffs in its Data Center Group (DCG) as part of CEO Lip-Bu Tan's broader effort to create a 'more focused and efficient' company. items.summary: Deep-dive analysis of AMD's Helios rack-scale strategy following Advancing AI 2026, examining the financial opportunity AMD is chasing with its integrated rack-scale approach, the competitive dynamics against NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72, and AMD's roadmap through Helios 500 and Helios 600 systems extend

items.title: Il Sole 24 Ore Highlights AI4I's SUK Platform for AI Technology Transfer to Italian SMEs
items.summary: AI4I, the Italian Institute for Artificial Intelligence for Industry, saw its SUK (System for User Knowledge) technology transfer platform featured in a full-page article on Il Sole 24 Ore. items.title: Italy's National AI Committee Chair Calls for Overcoming Sensationalist Narratives Around Artificial Intelligence
items.summary: Gianluigi Greco, president of Italy's National Committee for AI, told AI4Business that public debate on AI is polarized between unjustified alarmism and unrealistic expectations, urging strategic decisions anchored in scientific rigor rather than hype.

items.title: Emilia-Romagna's Food Valley Leverages AI to Expand into Global Markets
items.summary: The Food Valley industrial district in Emilia-Romagna is adopting artificial intelligence not only to innovate food production but increasingly to conquer new international markets, positioning the region as a global laboratory for AI-driven agrifood competitiveness.

items.title: Prentis, new AI lab co-founded by Reid Hoffman, Mark Pincus in talks to raise $100M
items.summary: $100M at $1B valuation, computer-use AI agents, seed stage, co-founded by Reid Hoffman and Mark Pincus, $50M in signed contracts, sector: AI agents/enterprise automation

items.title: Sam Altman's biometric startup World raises $52.5M via crypto sale
items.summary: $52.5M via WLD token sale with 12-month lockup, lead investor: Pantera Capital, joined by Bain Capital Crypto, Susquehanna Crypto, Selini Capital, sector: biometric AI/identity verification
